title: The status badge carries exactly three values
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a service advisor with view customers (and edit customers to add or change a record), on the build under test.
  2. Open an asset page and its Maintenance tab (the last tab, after Notes). The asset card is on the left; the Compliance section sits below Contact.
  3. A unit with services in due-soon, due-today and overdue states, plus one not due. Seed by backdating last-service dates and reminder timing so services fall in each state.
custom_steps:
1. Read the badge beside each service.
  2. Check when "due soon" starts (routine vs compliance).
  3. Look for any Active/Paused status or Ignore/Pause/Service history/Activity actions.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Status is a badge beside the service carrying exactly three values: due soon, due today, overdue; a service with no badge is tracked and nothing is due. It is a display on the asset and joins no other status set.
  • Due soon starts when the service's first reminder row is reached, and for a compliance service at its Remind before expiry.
  • There is no Active or Paused status, and no Ignore, Pause, Service history or Activity action.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780, story SV-10566 (S9, The asset Maintenance tab), Chunk 1 MR (Confluence 886931488) as edited 5 October 2026, S9 (unchanged requirements); read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.
